description.subtitle: Nike Big Mouth 650 ml bottle - black
description.intro: The Nike Big Mouth 2.0 650 ml bottle is designed to maintain hydration during workouts, matches and sports activity. Its flexible body and push-pull nozzle allow you to drink quickly and comfortably between exercises or during play breaks.
key_benefits: Handleable format: Its capacity of 650 ml offers a practical balance between hydration and ease of transport.
Quick use: The push-pull spout makes it easy to drink directly from the bottle during breaks.
Comfortable handling: Its flexible body allows you to press the bottle to facilitate the flow of the liquid.
Ready to train: Its functional design is suitable for taking to the field, to the gym or to use during any sports session.

source.subtitle: Botellín Nike Big Mouth 650 ml - negro
source.intro: El botellín Nike Big Mouth 2.0 650 ml está diseñado para mantener la hidratación durante entrenamientos, partidos y actividad deportiva. Su cuerpo flexible y su boquilla push-pull permiten beber de forma rápida y cómoda entre ejercicios o durante las pausas del juego.
key_benefits: Formato manejable: Su capacidad de 650 ml ofrece un equilibrio práctico entre hidratación y facilidad de transporte.
Uso rápido: La boquilla push-pull facilita beber directamente del botellín durante las pausas.
Manejo cómodo: Su cuerpo flexible permite presionar el botellín para facilitar la salida del líquido.
Preparado para entrenar: Su diseño funcional resulta adecuado para llevar al campo, al gimnasio o utilizar durante cualquier sesión deportiva.
